Name: Custom Warps
Author: f4iThh
Description:
[i]﻿Allows the player to set up custom warp points, easily![/i]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/f4iTh/StardewValleyModding/master/CustomWarps/docs/images/sample.png[/img]

[size=4][b]Usage[/b][/size]
The default keybind to open the menu is [font=Courier New]F7[/font], but this can be configured.

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
This mod has [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] support.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/f4iTh/StardewValleyModding/master/CustomWarps/docs/images/generic.png[/img]

Optionally, see [url=https://github.com/f4iTh/StardewValleyModding/tree/master/CustomWarps#configuration]README.md[/url].

[size=4][b]Adding a new warp[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Click the "Add warp" button on the warp menu to start adding a warp
[*]Left-click on the tile where you want to set up a warp point
[*]Choose a fitting name for your new warp point, and whether you want to make your new warp work across all saves (by toggling the "make warp global?" checkbox under the text box)
[*]Press enter to save the new warp, after which it should show up in the warp menu
[/list]
[size=4][b]Removing an existing warp[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Click the "Remove warp" button to enable warp removal
[*]Left-click the warp in the menu you want to remove
[*]Selecting the "Yes" option will successfully remove the selected warp
[/list]
[size=4]﻿[b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/url]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4][b]See also﻿[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/f4iTh/StardewValleyModding/tree/master/CustomWarps]Source code[/url]
[/list]
